panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: True tx-byte throughput of endorser vs ranking/Praos blocks, from cardano-db-sync: sum(tx.size) of each block's txs, split by has_leios_cert (an EB's txs are attributed to its certifying block). On-chain payload ground truth - not the tiny eb_announcement_size (which is only tx references).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(b.time, $__interval), coalesce(sum(t.size) FILTER (WHERE b.has_leios_cert), 0)::float / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "endorser blocks (EB)", coalesce(sum(t.size) FILTER (WHERE NOT b.has_leios_cert), 0)::float / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "ranking blocks (Praos)" FROM block b JOIN tx t ON t.block_id = b.id WHERE $__timeFilter(b.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tx Byte Throughput - Endorser vs Ranking Blocks

panels.description: Instantaneous TRUE payload of every block (one dot per block) = sum(tx.size) of its txs, split EB vs ranking by has_leios_cert. From cardano-db-sync - real on-chain tx bytes, not eb_announcement_size.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  b.time AS "time",
  CASE WHEN b.has_leios_cert THEN sum(t.size) END AS "endorser block (EB)",
  CASE WHEN NOT b.has_leios_cert THEN sum(t.size) END AS "ranking block (RB)"
FROM block b
JOIN tx t ON t.block_id = b.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.time)
GROUP BY b.id, b.time, b.has_leios_cert
ORDER BY b.time

panels.title: Endorser vs Ranking Block Sizes (per block)

panels.description: Average TRUE payload per certified endorser block = sum(tx.size) of all EB-carried txs / number of EB-bearing (has_leios_cert) blocks, from cardano-db-sync (on-chain certified payload, not eb_announcement_size).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(t.size)::float / nullif(count(DISTINCT b.id), 0) AS "avg EB payload" FROM block b JOIN tx t ON t.block_id = b.id WHERE b.has_leios_cert AND $__timeFilter(b.time)

panels.description: Per-node EB adoption delay = acquired_at - (system start + EB slot). Source: sidecar table eb_adoption (LeiosBlockAcquired traces).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), region AS metric, avg(delay) AS "delay (s)" FROM eb_adoption WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND kind = 'LeiosBlockAcquired' GROUP BY 1, region ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval), region AS metric, avg(delay) AS "delay (s)" FROM block_adoption WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY 1, region ORDER BY 1

Mempool composition (tx-firehose colours)
Mempool fill by origin per node (latest in range)
panels.description: Each node's latest mempool snapshot as a share of its capacity (bytes): coloured by tx-firehose origin (NA ff0000, EU 00c000, AS 0060ff; Other is untagged or unknown), grey is free space. A full bar with mixed colours means a full, fragmented mempool. Source: sidecar tables mempool_snapshots and mempool_colors.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT node, max(ts) AS ts
  FROM mempool_snapshots
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND capacity > 0
  GROUP BY node
), shares AS (
  SELECT s.node, s.bytes::float / s.capacity AS fill, c.color,
         c.txs::float / nullif(s.drained, 0) AS share
  FROM latest l
  JOIN mempool_snapshots s USING (node, ts)
  LEFT JOIN mempool_colors c USING (node, ts)
)
SELECT node AS "Node",
  100 * max(fill) * coalesce(sum(share) FILTER (WHERE color = 'ff0000'), 0) AS "NA",
  100 * max(fill) * coalesce(sum(share) FILTER (WHERE color = '00c000'), 0) AS "EU",
  100 * max(fill) * coalesce(sum(share) FILTER (WHERE color = '0060ff'), 0) AS "AS",
  100 * max(fill) * coalesce(sum(share) FILTER (WHERE color NOT IN ('ff0000', '00c000', '0060ff')), 0) AS "Other",
  100 * greatest(0, 1 - max(fill)) AS "Free"
FROM shares
GROUP BY node
ORDER BY node

panels.description: Share of the selected node's mempool capacity (bytes) held by each tx-firehose origin; the stack's height is how full the mempool is. Source: sidecar tables mempool_snapshots and mempool_colors.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.ts, $__interval), c.color AS metric,
  avg(100.0 * s.bytes / s.capacity * c.txs / nullif(s.drained, 0)) AS pct
FROM mempool_snapshots s
JOIN mempool_colors c USING (node, ts)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.node = '$node' AND s.capacity > 0
GROUP BY 1, c.color
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mempool fill by origin over time ($node)

panels.description: Share of a pool node's mempool that would have to change to match the average pool node's colour mix (total variation distance): mean over nodes and the worst node. 0 means every pool node holds the same mix. Pool nodes only; c1-c4 hold only their own generator's txs. Source: sidecar tables mempool_snapshots and mempool_colors.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_node AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS time, node, sum(drained) AS total
  FROM mempool_snapshots
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND drained > 0 AND node ~ '^p[0-9]+(bp|r[0-9])$'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), colours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT color FROM mempool_colors
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND node ~ '^p[0-9]+(bp|r[0-9])$'
), counts AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS time, node, color, sum(txs) AS n
  FROM mempool_colors
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND node ~ '^p[0-9]+(bp|r[0-9])$'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), shares AS (
  SELECT p.time, p.node, k.color, coalesce(c.n, 0)::float / p.total AS share
  FROM per_node p
  CROSS JOIN colours k
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.time = p.time AND c.node = p.node AND c.color = k.color
), mix AS (
  SELECT time, color, avg(share) AS share FROM shares GROUP BY 1, 2
), distance AS (
  SELECT s.time, s.node, 0.5 * sum(abs(s.share - m.share)) AS d
  FROM shares s
  JOIN mix m ON m.time = s.time AND m.color = s.color
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT time, 100 * avg(d) AS "mean", 100 * max(d) AS "worst node"
FROM distance
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Transactions in each node's mempool at each mempool-monitor snapshot. Source: sidecar table mempool_snapshots.

targets.rawSql:

FROM mempool_snapshots
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, node

panels.description: Seconds each snapshot took to walk the mempool; keep it well below MEMPOOL_MONITOR_INTERVAL. Source: sidecar table mempool_snapshots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), node AS metric, max(drain_secs) AS drain_secs
FROM mempool_snapshots
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, node

EB transaction availability (fragmentation)

panels.description: Of the txs in the EBs pool nodes received, the share already in their mempool (LeiosBodyHits mempoolHits / txsInEb). 100% means nothing had to be fetched. Pool nodes only, the EB's forger excluded. Source: sidecar table eb_body_hits.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(h.ts, $__interval), h.region AS metric,
  100.0 * sum(h.mempool_hits) / nullif(sum(h.txs_in_eb), 0) AS hit_rate
FROM eb_body_hits h
WHERE $__timeFilter(h.ts)
  AND h.host ~ '^p[0-9]+(bp|r[0-9])$'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM eb_adoption a
    WHERE a.host = h.host AND a.eb_hash = h.eb_hash AND a.kind = 'LeiosBlockForged')
GROUP BY 1, h.region
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EB mempool hit rate by region (pool nodes)

panels.description: Bytes/s of EB txs pool nodes received from peers, summed: needed (not in mempool or cache) and redundant (already held). Source: node counters leiosFetchTxsGoodBytes / leiosFetchTxsExtraBytes.
panels.title: EB tx bytes fetched, pool nodes

panels.description: Bytes/s of EB txs each client received from peers: needed and redundant. Clients receive no txs into their mempools, so they fetch every EB's txs. Source: node counters leiosFetchTxsGoodBytes / leiosFetchTxsExtraBytes.
panels.title: EB tx bytes fetched, clients (c1-c4)
Included txs by origin, per forging region
panels.description: Of the txs the blocks and EBs forged by each region included in the selected range, the share from each tx-firehose origin (NA ff0000, EU 00c000, AS 0060ff; Other is untagged). An even mix means txs had spread to every region before inclusion; a dominant own colour means forgers mostly saw their region's txs. Regions follow global_network_leios (pools 1, 5 NA; 2, 4, 6 EU; 3 AS). Scans every included tx in the range. Source: cardano-db-sync.

targets.rawSql:
WITH regions(pool_no, region) AS (
  VALUES (1, 'NA'), (2, 'EU'), (3, 'AS'), (4, 'EU'), (5, 'NA'), (6, 'EU')
), pool_region AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pu.hash_id, r.region
  FROM pool_relay pr
  JOIN pool_update pu ON pu.id = pr.update_id
  JOIN regions r ON pr.dns_name = 'p' || r.pool_no || '.example'
), block_region AS (
  SELECT b.id, pr.region
  FROM block b
  JOIN slot_leader sl ON sl.id = b.slot_leader_id
  JOIN pool_region pr ON pr.hash_id = sl.pool_hash_id
), blk AS (
  -- A certifying block carries only the certificate; its txs are the EB its parent announced.
  SELECT b.id,
         CASE WHEN b.has_leios_cert THEN rp.region || ' EBs' ELSE r.region || ' blocks' END AS forger
  FROM block b
  JOIN block_region r ON r.id = b.id
  LEFT JOIN block_region rp ON rp.id = b.previous_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(b.time)
)
SELECT forger AS "Forger",
  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.json::text = '"0xff0000"') / count(*) AS "NA",
  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.json::text = '"0x00c000"') / count(*) AS "EU",
  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.json::text = '"0x0060ff"') / count(*) AS "AS",
  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(m.json::text, '') NOT IN ('"0xff0000"', '"0x00c000"', '"0x0060ff"')) / count(*) AS "Other"
FROM blk
JOIN tx t ON t.block_id = blk.id
LEFT JOIN tx_metadata m ON m.tx_id = t.id AND m.key = 1022
WHERE blk.forger IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY forger
ORDER BY forger
